title: Evaluating AI-Based Mitosis Detection for Breast Carcinoma in Digital Pathology: A Clinical Study on Routine Practice Integration.
summary: With AI assistance, two pathologists improved mitotic scoring accuracy against expert consensus on routine-practice breast-cancer whole-slide images (62%/64% to 76%/78%) and improved interobserver agreement; the evaluation was limited to one hospital and a 50-case reading study.
ai_technology: An AI mitosis-detection/hotspot workflow assists pathologists reading whole-slide images and contributes mitotic evidence to routine scoring.

evidence.tested: With AI assistance, two pathologists improved mitotic scoring accuracy against expert consensus on routine-practice breast-cancer whole-slide images (62%/64% to 76%/78%) and improved interobserver agreement; the evaluation was limited to one hospital and a 50-case reading study.
